[[Baron/Legends|Baron]] '''Alde''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] noble [[House Alde]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he requested the head of [[Darth Bandon]] from the [[Royal Museum of Alderaan|House Alde Royal Museum]] to present as a peace offering to [[Bouris Ulgo]].
